about.title: How My Food AI works
about.description: Take a photo, type a description, or speak to log your meal. My Food AI identifies your food, estimates portions, and records the nutrition consumed. You can edit any entry. The app provides no advice, sets no targets, and makes no health claims.
about.upload: The photo is uploaded and the meal appears in your feed at once, marked as being analysed.
about.outline: SAM 3.1 outlines each food in the photo.
about.name: Muse Spark 1.3 names each food and estimates its portion.
about.source: Nutrition values come from nutrition labels, food reference data, or labelled model estimates.
about.correction: The meal shows every food, its portion and the nutrition consumed. Tap a food to correct it, or write or say a correction such as “I ate half the rice”; the earlier version is kept.
about.leftovers: A photo of the leftovers, marked as not eaten, takes the uneaten part out of the record.
about.samJob: Outlines each food in a meal photo.
about.sparkJob: Names the foods and their portions, reads nutrition labels, interprets corrections and picks the matching USDA reference.
about.voiceJob: Turns a spoken correction into text for you to confirm.
about.openJob: An optional path for naming foods and portions, switched on under Profile. SAM and transcription stay on the Meta API.
about.modelNote: Every model call is recorded with the model that answered. USDA FoodData Central and Open Food Facts are databases, not models.
about.dataDescription: Only your signed-in account can view your meals in the app. Anyone with a photo's unguessable link can open it, but the app does not publish these links.

support.title: Freeze report
support.explanation: If the app froze, you can send the last 20 technical events, your browser details, the app build, and the camera permission. The report has no photos, no meal text, and no names. Nothing is sent until you tap Send.
support.failed: The report was not sent. You can try again.
support.rateLimited: You sent a report a moment ago. Try again in a minute.
support.historyUnavailable: The technical history could not be read. Nothing was sent.
